paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Stellar/solar energy-loss bound from SNO all-flavor solar neutrino flux. Axion-photon limit g_aγ < 7e-10 GeV^-1 valid for sub-keV masses (limit applies up to ma~0.2 eV where helioscope/Primakoff argument holds). The single value is mass-independent in this range; I approximated as flat from ~1e-3 to 0.1 eV. The paper also gives mass-dependent boson-electron Yukawa limits (PS: g_eeχ<2.8e-11, S:2.4e-13, V:1.7e-13 at mχ=0) shown in Fig.1 up to ~10 keV, which would correspond to AxionElectron (PS case g_ae).
